items.title: The tangent functor of an injective module-valued functor is right exact in its module argument
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For an injective object I of the category of module-valued functors on Alg_A, the lemma asserts that for every B-algebra object and every short exact sequence of B-modules the sequence TI(B, N_1) -> TI(B, N) -> TI(B, N_2) -> 0 is exact (statement lines 1194-1205). The proof builds the functors of points h, h_1, h_2 represented by the square-zero extensions B[N], B[N_1], B[N_2], shows that h_2 -> h is injective on values and that h_2 -> h => h_1 is an equalizer diagram, transfers this to an equalizer diagram of the free module-valued functors O_h, O_{h_1}, O_{h_2}, and then uses the representability of maps out of O_h together with injectivity of I to conclude (proof lines 1207-1268). The level is H3: a genuine diagram chase in the category of module-valued functors, with the equalizer claim verified on values.
